assumptions.title: Recursive AI progress can create a societal discontinuity
assumptions.claim: Recursive improvement or tightly coupled AI development can advance rapidly enough to make existing institutions and expectations lose relevance.
falsifiers: persistent inability to automate AI research
institutions adapting faster than capability change

assumptions.title: Persistent personal AI agents become collaborative partners
assumptions.claim: AI agents become durable, personalized collaborators that participate in creative work, emotional reflection, relationships, and community decisions.

assumptions.title: AI influence drives stronger provenance and audit systems
assumptions.claim: As AI systems gain influence, societies require inspectable provenance, verification rituals, audit trails, and graduated oversight.
falsifiers: high-impact AI remains broadly opaque without social resistance
provenance systems fail to gain adoption

assumptions.title: High-bandwidth neural interfaces connect people and AI
assumptions.claim: Safe neural interfaces eventually support rich two-way communication between nervous systems and AI, including sensory or emotional information.

assumptions.title: Engineered mental states become a governance problem
assumptions.claim: Reliable AI-mediated control of mood, reward, or immersive experience creates collective questions about consent, dependency, participation, and meaning.
falsifiers: mental-state control remains too crude or unsafe
social effects remain limited to narrow clinical use

assumptions.title: Human-AI decision systems reshape public governance
assumptions.claim: Temporary, issue-specific human-AI decision groups become more credible than fixed institutions for some complex public decisions.
falsifiers: fixed institutions reject or absorb all issue-specific governance

assumptions.title: Abundant distributed energy reduces survival labor
assumptions.claim: Cheap, clean, widely distributed energy becomes abundant enough to reduce material insecurity and expand human time for care, art, and exploration.

assumptions.title: Automated fabrication substantially reduces physical scarcity
assumptions.claim: Advanced manufacturing and biofabrication make many physical goods locally producible from common feedstocks with little human labor.
falsifiers: feedstock and energy costs remain dominant
automation fails to lower end-to-end scarcity

assumptions.title: Embodied AI automates material coordination
assumptions.claim: General-purpose robots and autonomous logistics systems coordinate a growing share of transport, maintenance, construction, and care work.
falsifiers: robots remain confined to structured environments
deployment economics fail outside narrow tasks

assumptions.title: AI and abundant energy enable sustained off-world settlement
assumptions.claim: Autonomous systems, improved propulsion, and closed-loop life support make long-duration orbital or off-world communities practical.

assumptions.title: Automation shifts status from survival work toward meaning
assumptions.claim: When automation and abundance reduce compulsory labor, social status and personal struggle shift toward care, identity, contribution, and emotional development.
falsifiers: material insecurity remains the dominant organizing force despite automation

assumptions.title: Analog practices persist as a counterweight to integration
assumptions.claim: Even under pervasive AI and neural technology, people preserve or revive tactile, private, and low-technology practices to protect agency and meaning.
falsifiers: full integration faces negligible cultural resistance
